diffSummary: Bootstrap now returns up to 500 cross-day audit events while the daily log remains filtered to the current business date.
Audit events expose scene, previousScene and nextScene derived server-side without exposing before/after snapshots.
Deleted and sold records remain discoverable in module history.
Repair-to-pickup events belong to both repair and pickup histories.
Cross-day audit events are read-only; undo is enforced as current-business-day only on the API.
Reverted events expose the actual revert timestamp.
rationale: Restore complete operational traceability across days and lifecycle removal without leaking encrypted audit snapshots to the browser.
